title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Audit user and group permissions across apps (new Permissions Overview page)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 introduces a new Permissions Overview page that provides centralized visibility into permission sets across all installed apps and extensions. This feature helps administrators audit user and group permissions, analyze permission dependencies, and manage access control more efficiently.
key_points: The Permissions Overview page displays permission sets from Microsoft, ISV applications, and user-defined sets in a single unified view
Administrators can filter permissions by object, scope, extension, or permission set to quickly locate specific access rules
The page shows which permission sets grant access to specific objects and which security groups and users are assigned to each set
This centralized approach simplifies security audits, permission dependency analysis, and troubleshooting access issues
features: permission filtering by object, scope, extension
security group and user assignment display

quotes.text: The new Permissions Overview page provides comprehensive visibility into permission sets across all installed apps and extensions.
quotes.why_it_matters: This explains the core functionality that centralizes permission management across multiple sources.

quotes.text: This centralized view helps administrators analyze permission dependencies, conduct security audits, and troubleshoot access issues without navigating multiple pages or extensions.
quotes.why_it_matters: This describes the practical benefit that saves administrators time and improves security oversight.
